edges.reason: nameArt authorizes the caller with require(msg.sender == ownerOf(_id)) before writing the name
setUsername keys the usernames mapping directly on msg.sender
commissionArt requires msg.sender == ownerOf(_foundation) before creating the commissioned tulip
originalArtwork passes msg.sender as the owner of the newly created tulip
_creativeProcess mixes msg.sender into the keccak256 entropy used to derive the genome
_checkOnERC721Received forwards msg.sender as the operator argument of onERC721Received
commissionArt calls _createTulip to push and mint the commissioned tulip
commissionArt returns the result of _creativeProcess(_id) which computes the genome
originalArtwork calls _createTulip with the supplied genome and no parents
_createTulip calls _safeMint to mint the new tulip id to the owner
_safeMint invokes _checkOnERC721Received which performs an external callback to the recipient
_checkOnERC721Received performs an untrusted external call to onERC721Received before state is fully settled
_creativeProcess uses blockhash(block.number-1)/blockhash(block.number-2) as miner-influenceable randomness for the genome
withdraw sends the full contract balance to owner() via transfer after which reentrancy is theoretically possible if owner is a contract
withdraw is guarded by onlyOwner which reads the stored _owner address
nameArt writes the artwork name into the names mapping
setUsername writes the new username into the usernames mapping
getTulip reads the tulips array to return the requested tulip fields
_createTulip pushes a new Tulip struct onto the tulips array
_creativeProcess reads foundation/inspiration tulips and writes the derived genome back into tulips[_id]
commissionArt gates the price on totalSupply() against COMMISSION_ARTWORK_LIMIT
originalArtwork gates minting on totalSupply() < ORIGINAL_ARTWORK_LIMIT
commissionArt uses ownerOf(_foundation) to verify the caller owns the foundation tulip

normalization_plan.reason: Token id parameter is only meaningful as the access-control subject of nameArt
Name string parameter flows directly into names[_id] inside nameArt
Username parameter is stored verbatim in usernames[msg.sender] inside setUsername
Foundation id parameter drives the ownership check and generation lookup in commissionArt
Inspiration id parameter is forwarded to _createTulip by commissionArt
Genome parameter is passed directly to _createTulip from originalArtwork
Id parameter selects the tulip whose genome is computed within _creativeProcess
Local hash is the observable product of the blockhash-based randomness used by _creativeProcess
Accumulated genome local is written into tulips[_id] by _creativeProcess
